meta.title: Market Intelligence — B2B insights for strategic industries
meta.description: Market intelligence platform for mining, energy, lithium, green hydrogen and desalination in Chile: news, projects, companies, data and research.

slides.mineria: Investment pipeline, operations and suppliers across large-scale mining, with actionable data for your commercial team.
slides.energia: Generation, transmission and storage: Chile's power pipeline with development stages and owners.
slides.litio: Salt flats, installed capacity and long-term contracts: the lithium ecosystem in a single view.
slides.hidrogeno: The green hydrogen and ammonia projects redrawing the country's export matrix.
slides.desalinizacion: Desalination plants in operation and under review, with capacity, industrial clients and timelines.

about.title: Who we are
about.p1: Market Intelligence is a B2B market-intelligence platform focused on Chile's strategic industries: mining, energy, lithium, green hydrogen and desalination.
about.p2: We pair a specialised editorial team with structured data on projects, companies and executives, so commercial and strategy teams decide on evidence and get there before their competition.
